candidates.name: Goomba link package preflight and symlink lifecycle
candidates.proposed_use: Reuse the package linker's destination-resolution checks and no-follow unlink mechanics as building blocks for wheel link integration.

citations.section: Overview L194–203; ErrUnsafePath L257–260; Unlink L335–338; Link L459–466

candidates.opened_evidence: The supplier API confines resolved destinations to an environment prefix and sources to the package directory, validates planned writes, recreates symlinks, and removes links without following them.
candidates.remaining_adapter: Translate wheel metadata into its conda-oriented model and enforce the narrower set of package roots supplied by this wheel. Missing-target and bounded-cycle rejection are not established; those core validation requirements remain.
candidates.limitations: Conda installation is the supplied actor/output, not Wheel-Version 2.0/LINKS. Prefix containment alone permits a broader domain than same-wheel package containment. No complete frozen partial validator or whole installer is claimed. The draft's source/target orientation ambiguity remains unresolved; no package was installed.

candidates.name: Bazel FilesetOutputTree relative-symlink traversal
candidates.proposed_use: Reuse the bounded relative-link traversal algorithm when designing the graph-checking portion of a wheel-link validator.

citations.section: MAX_SYMLINK_TRAVERSALS L44; relative resolution L278–319; full resolution and error handling L228–275

candidates.opened_evidence: Implementation tracks seen links and a 256-traversal bound. Cyclic, too-long and unresolved links produce warnings and are omitted from the resolved mapping.
candidates.remaining_adapter: Convert fileset inputs, enforce both endpoint containment and extracted-target existence, and turn incomplete resolution into a rejecting validation result. The implementation currently warns rather than rejects the entire link plan.
candidates.limitations: Internal Bazel component, not a wheel installer or ready-made complete validator. Its treatment of missing/outside targets tolerates omissions. The initial draft's direction ambiguity is preserved; no execution or suitability of all dependencies was tested.

context.isolation: Separate Route A worker; no Route B results or other route judgments supplied or read.
context.subsequent_input_authorization: Root authorized all even inputs after B scheduling prerequisites; no B content supplied.
